messages:
elaine-cust: Hi team — I tried to pay invoice INV-2026-0123 just now and the card was declined. UX shows 'Authentication required' and the gateway returned card_declined. Can you check?

anna-support: Sorry you're hitting this, @elaine-cust. Can you confirm last4 of the card and which invoice? Also did you try the 3DS popup?

elaine-cust: last4 4242, invoice INV-2026-0123. I saw a modal but it errored with 'challenge failed' after I entered the code.

anna-support: Thanks — passing to billing. @kevin-billing can you pull the payment attempt? Thread ts 1766123456.

kevin-billing: Got it. Looking at gateway logs — payment attempt id pay_1JqX... returned decline_code: insufficient_funds and reason: authentication_required. Gateway also shows 3DS flow started but final status 'failed_challenge'.

kevin-billing: Can you confirm the customer's billing country? 3DS behavior varies for EU VAT/extra auth.

elaine-cust: I'm in the UK. VAT settings on the invoice look fine.

anna-support: Ok — two parallel tracks: (1) short-term: suggest customer try a different card or pay by wire/PO; (2) we escalate to payments vendor to see why issuer rejected the 3DS challenge.

josh-engineer: Adding some logs from our side — here's the attempt payload we sent to the gateway:
```
POST /v1/payments
{
  "amount": 49900,
  "currency": "gbp",
  "payment_method": "pm_1JqW...",
  "confirm": true,
  "return_url": "https://app.redwood.ai/payments/3ds/return"
}
```
Gateway response: `status: requires_action, next_action: redirect_to_url (3ds2)`, later `status: failed` with code `authentication_failed`.

payments-bot: Automated note: payment gateway response code AUTH-3DS-401, correlation_id c_8b9f. Logged to ticket PG-1129.

kevin-billing: I opened PG ticket PG-1129 with gateway-ops and attached the full request/response. Asking them to check ACS routing and 3DS version negotiation (a lot of issuers reject 3DS2 challenges if the merchant isn't on an allowlist).

gateway-ops: We see the 3DS flow reached the issuer but ACS sent back 'challenge not completed' from issuer side. Request to gateway: can you provide ECI/CAVV/DS results? Also confirm if fallback to 3DS1 was attempted.

josh-engineer: From our logs ECI was 05, DS return code 'N' for not authenticated. We didn't see a 3DS1 fallback attempt — our gateway is configured to prefer 3DS2 only.

kevin-billing: Action items: 1) @elaine-cust — if you need immediate access, try another card or send PO/wire to billing@redwood.ai; 2) @gateway-ops escalate with issuer (PG-1129) and confirm whether the ACS challenge failed due to device/browser; 3) @josh-engineer we'll capture a full HAR of the 3DS redirect to share with the gateway.

elaine-cust: I'm happy to try another card but it's the company card. Finance prefers PO. Is there a way to get a manual invoice to pay by bank transfer?

kevin-billing: Yes — we can issue a manual invoice and include bank details. Will need company name, VAT id (if any), and PO number. I can draft it now.

anna-support: Also documenting repro steps in case the gateway asks for them:
1) Create invoice INV-2026-0123 for 499.00 GBP
2) Attempt card payment via web checkout using Chrome on macOS 13
3) Enter card ending 4242 when prompted
4) 3DS modal appears, complete fields -> modal errors with 'challenge failed'
5) Network tab shows redirect to ACS and final POST with status failed and code AUTH-3DS-401

kevin-billing: If payments vendor confirms issuer-side fraud/funds issue, we'll mark attempt as 'card_declined: insufficient_funds' and offer alternatives. If it's ACS/3DS flow bug, vendor will advise fix.

gateway-ops: Update from PG-1129: issuer returned 'challenge incomplete' and flagged as potential fraud. They recommend cardholder call their bank to authorize the merchant or try with a different payment method. They're also investigating 3DS device fingerprinting mismatch.

anna-support: OK — relaying options to customer and offering a manual bank transfer invoice to unblock.

elaine-cust: Thanks — please send the bank transfer invoice and I'll have finance process a PO. Also let me know if you need the HAR file from my end.

kevin-billing: Sending invoice via email now. Please include an email to finance@acme.example with PO# if available. We'll keep PG-1129 open and update thread when gateway confirms root cause. :thumbsup:

payments-bot: Ticket PG-1129 updated: awaiting issuer logs.

anna-support: Closing loop here — customer offered alternatives, invoice sent. We'll re-open if gateway finds merchant-side issue. Filing internal postmortem notes under #incidents if PG-1129 surfaces a platform change.

elaine-cust: Appreciated, team.
